items.message: Collision check in `_reconcile` reads the remote tree but the index being built is local; a non-fast-forward retry might re-enter `_reconcile` after a partial index write, leaving no rollback.
`push()` on the second clone may fast-forward rather than reconcile if the remote ref is ahead; the test depends on a race that the test infrastructure does not enforce.
